name: sql-migration-generator
description: Generates Flyway migration scripts for SQL Server from the changes on an SSDT database branch: a versioned V__ script written from the diff by rule, and a repeatable R__ script built deterministically from the source files in dependency order. Checks that both deploy in order (seed before foreign key, column before use, nothing used after a drop), maps SQLCMD variables, and keeps the deploy-role grants and .sqlproj items in step.
